_about: Short 'where to get it' lines for resources that have no source line on enshrouded.tools. Each is summarised from that resource's own note in the other JSON files here (site text or the pre-1.0 wiki). make_craft_js.py uses one only when a resource has no source of its own.
Animal Fur: wildlife and Vukah drops; loose in the world
Bones: wildlife and Hollow drops; mine bone piles
Stone: small stones on the ground; mine rocks
